Done. I've implemented all three functions:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js — constrains n to the inclusive range [min, max]
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — formats byte counts as human-readable strings (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
3. **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — converts titles to URL-friendly slugs (lowercase, trimmed, spaces become dashes, non-alphanumeric characters stripped)

All functions are exported and follow the project's code style conventions.
